title: Book Two · Chapter 157: This Week
story:
Two notices lie on Ronan's desk for the third practice. The first gives the usual opening day: Wednesday afternoon. The second gives this week's day. It is different.

His stomach tightens. He remembers the wrong Wednesday in the old booklet. Jun held that booklet too.

He sets his pencil down. He reads the date on the first notice. Then he reads the date on the second.

This week, workers need the reading room on Wednesday. Students can use it on Thursday afternoon instead. The change is only for one week.

Ronan writes three short answers. He puts the new date beside the new day.

Miss Wu comes to his table.

“A student has the first notice,” she says. “She wants to come on Wednesday. What do you tell her?”

“This week, the room opens on Thursday afternoon. The new notice changes the old one.”

“And next week?”

Ronan looks down again. “The usual Wednesday time returns next week.”

“Can you show that?”

He points to the words only this week. Then he points to the old notice. He explains the two pages in order. He speaks slowly. Miss Wu can follow each date.

She asks one more question about the workers. The page does not say what the workers will do.

“It does not say,” Ronan answers. “I can tell the student about the opening time.”

Miss Wu makes her mark. Ronan turns the paper over and waits for the end.

Outside, a strong wind moves the leaves across the yard. He watches a leaf slide under the door. It catches against a chair leg and stays there.

When the papers come back, he sees a good result. He did this task without help. He now has two good results from three tasks.

He puts the page away carefully. He wants to hold it up toward Jun's table. He wants Jun to see the right Wednesday answer.

Jun is reading his own paper. Ronan leaves him to it.

At the door, the wind lifts Mei's page. She catches one corner. Ronan holds the door still while she puts it in her bag.

“Thank you,” she says. “My notice almost changed rooms.”

“It needs a new date first.”

She smiles. They walk toward the yard. Jun follows a few steps behind.

That evening, Ronan takes the paper out at home. Mum reads his answers while the soup warms. She asks about the two different weeks, and he shows her the dates.

“Now I understand,” she says.

He closes the folder before dinner. He does not show her the page a second time. Dad asks for the salt. Ronan passes it. Then the three of them begin to eat.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

instead＝作为替代；usual＝通常的；only this week＝仅限本周；in order＝按顺序。

## 理解问题

1. 两份通知怎样共同说明这周和下周的开放安排？
2. Ronan为什么想把正确答案举给Jun看，又没有这样做？

## 读句子

**The new notice changes the old one.**

拆开看：The new notice / changes / the old one.

新通知／更改了／旧通知的安排。
